{{Select Language|Hitman_Tool}}

'''Hitman Tool''' is a tool by anonimzwx for handling collisions and interactions in ''Super Mario World''. It lets you configure interactions from the original game (vanilla) and write custom responses for your sprites.

== Features ==

* '''Configurable hitboxes.''' A custom sprite can use the original game's clipping, a single box whose size and position are set in code, or several boxes per pose.
* '''Per-hitbox callbacks.''' For interactions with Mario, each box can run one routine when it collides and another when it does not.
* '''Configurable vanilla interactions.''' Read flags to see what hit a sprite or assign callbacks to respond immediately. Supported events include Mario and Yoshi fireballs, explosions, Quake sprites, and collisions between sprites. An enemy can react to a shell hit or turn around when it runs into another sprite.
* '''Extended sprite collisions.''' A custom projectile can use its own hitboxes to check for collisions with Mario or a Normal sprite.
* '''Custom properties.''' Add properties to Normal sprites, both vanilla and custom. For example, other sprites can read a property that says whether an enemy is large or small and respond accordingly.
* '''Reusable collision routines.''' Hitman includes routines that prepare hitboxes, check for collisions, and handle responses such as bouncing.
